intended_object: A chosen 2-simplex showing that `f.comp g` is a composite of the edges `f` and `g` in a 2-truncated quasicategory. It is picked with `Classical.choice` from the inner-horn filling axiom `fill21`; inferred from the body and from the companion `Edge.comp`.
explanation: The definition takes the second component of `(Quasicategory₂.fill21 f g).some`. `Edge.comp` takes the first component of the same choice, so this is exactly the 2-simplex that witnesses the chosen composite edge. The value is an arbitrary choice: it is fixed by `Classical.choice`, not by any canonical construction. Its role is to make the library's construction of the homotopy category of a 2-truncated quasicategory work. It is bookkeeping data paired with `Edge.comp`, not a standard notion from the literature with its own generality, so it is an auxiliary technical device. As such a device it is consistent with `Edge.comp` and does what its docstring says.
